audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the level chart was wrong in both layers, and each one contradicted its own why. The page said Olaf wins Levels 2 and 3 while whys[1] and whys[2] say 'Counter Strike turns the lane' and 'he can't kite the Leap Strike'; said Skill at Level 6 while whys[4] says Ragnarok neutralizes Jax's spike; and said Olaf at first item and 2+ items while whys[5] and whys[6] both call those a coinflip.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Olaf / Jax / Jax / Skill / Olaf / Skill / Skill and it matches the prose exactly — only the side tokens were out of step. Also diffRating 8.5/10 and 'Hard matchup' sat next to diff EVEN and a 52.35% Jax win rate.
audit.corrected: All six wrong rows flipped as matched full/content pairs; diffRating 6/10 and the difficulty and rating lines aligned to EVEN.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase whys for Levels 2, 3 and 6 were boilerplate with no numbers and, at Level 2, actively wrong ('take the trade when Ragnarok is down' — Ragnarok does not exist until 6).
audit.why: Real spike structure: Olaf owns level 1 on Undertow's slow and armor shred plus Berserker Rage lifesteal; Jax owns 2-3 once Counter Strike (17s at rank 1) exists against a champion with no dash; Ragnarok (100/90/80s) is his level-6 flip.
audit.corrected: Phase whys rewritten with Counter Strike's 17s, Reckless Swing's 11s and Ragnarok's 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate written as 'Grandmaster-at-Arms' in mid and 'Grandmaster at Arms' in late; the correct name is Grandmaster's Might. Undertow is described only as a slow — it also shreds Armor, which compounds with the fact that Reckless Swing is true damage.
audit.why: Fabricated ability name in two fields. The armor shred matters because the page tells the player to build Armor via Plated Steelcaps and rely on Grandmaster's Might resists, while Undertow reduces exactly that and Reckless Swing bypasses it entirely.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster's Might used; Undertow's armor shred stated alongside the slow.

audit.why: The page already identifies the axe-pickup reset correctly in spirit — Undertow is 9s flat but resets on pickup, so denying the axe by standing on it is the real cooldown play, and dosFull[1] says so.
audit.corrected: Reinforced with the 9s number in the Level 3 phase.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Olaf's Ragnarok is down.
edits.after: Counter Strike is online and Olaf has no dash — every auto he walks up to throw feeds your held dodge-stun.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Olaf must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Stand on his thrown axe to deny the pickup — Undertow is 9s without it, and that is the window your Leap Strike lives in.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Olaf's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ragnarok (100s at rank 1) makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so your stun does nothing — bait it before you commit.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ragnarok and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ragnarok and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Olaf carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Olaf carry threat 8/10.

edits.before: The whole mid-game hinges on Ragnarok. Olaf's R makes him CC-immune and cleanses your Counter Strike stun, so if he holds it your level 6 all-in does nothing but feed his true damage — this is his window, not yours. Bait it: start a trade, force him to pop R defensively, then disengage with the Leap Strike and come back once it's down. With anti-heal up and his Ragnarok on cooldown, your stun into the Grandmaster-at-Arms on-hit ramp grinds him out; without either, you give the lane away.
edits.after: The whole mid-game hinges on Ragnarok. Olaf's R makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so if he holds it your level 6 all-in does nothing but feed his true damage — his window, not yours. Bait it: start a trade, force him to pop R defensively, then disengage with the Leap Strike and come back inside its 100s. With anti-heal up and Ragnarok on cooldown, your stun into the Grandmaster's Might on-hit ramp grinds him out; without either, you give the lane away.

edits.before: This stays a coinflip side-lane duel all game — neither of you has the range to walk away from the other. Your edge is Grandmaster at Arms: the on-hit ramp plus the burst of Armor and MR lets you live through his Ragnarok window and out-DPS him after it expires. Keep anti-heal current so his lifesteal can't bail him, and remember his axe true damage cuts straight through your bonus Armor — so the fight is won by checking his R timer, not by stat-checking him. That one cooldown decides who takes the duel.
edits.after: This stays a coinflip side-lane duel all game — neither of you has the range to walk away from the other. Your edge is Grandmaster's Might: the on-hit ramp plus the burst of Armor and MR lets you live through his Ragnarok window and out-DPS him after it expires. Keep anti-heal current so his lifesteal can't bail him, and remember Undertow shreds your Armor while Reckless Swing is true damage — so the fight is won by checking his R timer, not by stat-checking him.

edits.before: Olaf owns level 1: he has axe-slow and lifesteal before your Counter Strike exists, so don't auto-trade into him yet. Your turn starts at level 2-3. Olaf has no dash, so he must physically walk up to auto you — hold E, let him commit his fists, then recast for the stun and Empower the Leap Strike back in. Don't waste E on a lone axe-throw; the slow lands regardless since it isn't an auto, so save the dodge for his autos. Trade in this window before his lifesteal stacks and you come out ahead.
edits.after: Olaf owns level 1: Undertow slows AND shreds your Armor, and his passive gives lifesteal, all before Counter Strike exists — don't auto-trade yet. Your turn starts at 2-3. He has no dash, so he must walk up to auto you: hold E, let him commit his fists, then recast for the stun and Empower the Leap Strike back in. Don't spend E on a lone axe throw — the slow lands regardless since it isn't an auto. Stand on the fallen axe to deny his 9s reset.

notes: All seven level-chart rows were wrong on this page while the whys[] text was right — the sides were simply inverted against the packet chart and against the page's own prose. Also fixed 'Grandmaster-at-Arms' / 'Grandmaster at Arms' for Grandmaster's Might. UNVERIFIED, left alone: the page claims Ragnarok 'cleanses' an already-applied Counter Strike stun. Riot's text only says he becomes immune to disables while attacking; whether activation removes existing CC is not in the kit file, so I reworded to the text's own wording rather than assert either way — worth a human check.
